hints.content:
$\blueE{8\%}$ $\purpleE{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{94}$ is the same as $\blueE{8\%}\purpleE{\times}\maroonD{94}$.

To solve $\blueE{8\%}\purpleE{\times}\maroonD{94}$, we need to convert $\blueE{8\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueE{8\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueE{\dfrac{8}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueE{8\div 100=0.08}$.

$\blueE{8\%= \dfrac{8}{100} = 0.08}$

$\begin{align}\blueE{8\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{94}&=\blueE{\dfrac{8}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{94}\\\\
&=\blueE{0.08}\cdot\maroonD{94}\\\\
&=7.52
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

$0.8\cdot 94=75.2$

The expression $0.8\cdot 94$ is **not** equivalent to $8\%$ of $94$.

$800\cdot 94=75{,}200$

The expression $800\cdot 94$ is **not** equivalent to $8\%$ of $94$.

$8\cdot 94=752$

The expression $8\cdot 94$ is **not** equivalent to $8\%$ of $94$.

The options that have the same value as $8\%$ of $94$ are:

- $\dfrac{8}{100}\cdot 94$
- $0.08\cdot 94$
